changes: Raise the bounded production account-attempt ceiling from 3 to 16 while retaining the 120-second total deadline and 100-2000 ms backoff.
Keep automatic replay restricted to an initial request before semantic output.
Compact the lower-left account menu and preserve Weekly quota, reset time, observation time, cooldown, add, delete, and manual switch controls.
Retain the language-neutral Safari profile-menu discovery introduced by R109.

residual_risks: The four-account proof is fixture-only; no real model request or real cross-account automatic switch was sent in R110.
The independent 120-second deadline can stop before all 16 accounts when earlier upstream attempts stall.
Switching selects a new backend session; cross-account continuity and in-place recovery are not verified.
Safari pixel-level verification remains blocked by macOS ScreenCaptureKit SCStream -3811.
